Lake Lowell Animal Rescue serves animals in need near Lake Lowell in the Nampa/Caldwell area in Idaho. We are a 501(C)3 nonprofit animal rescue organization. This channel serves as a repository for videos of animals that are being fostered and are available for adoption. We share these videos on our website and social media to reach potential adopters. To adopt an animal, or to learn more about our organization, please find us on Facebook or visit our website:

www.lakelowellanimalrescue.org
